takeaways.title: Static profiles cluster by class
takeaways.body: On World Values Survey wave 7 (N=2,000), human SES groups overlap (silhouette -0.02), while Llama-8B agents conditioned on the same labels separate (0.19).

takeaways.title: LifeMem cuts KL on both surveys
takeaways.body: Llama-8B Add Health KL falls from 8.67 (Profile) and 5.83 (Event RAG) to 4.0635. Understanding Society KL falls to 3.4529.

takeaways.title: Both memories are doing work
takeaways.body: Dropping parametric memory or structured retrieval raises KL on every backbone. Retrieval supplies question-specific evidence; LoRA keeps unretrieved experience.

takeaways.title: Same ranking on a synthetic panel
takeaways.body: With the paper's K=5, alpha=0.9, and metrics, LifeMem KL is 1.647 vs Profile 10.727 and Direct 16.393 on 24 synthetic agents.

takeaways.title: Profile agents still look essentialist
takeaways.body: Last-wave SES silhouette is -0.010 for synthetic humans, 1.000 for Profile, and -0.025 for LifeMem.

takeaways.title: Cheaper than Event RAG
takeaways.body: On Add Health, LifeMem averages 161.7 ms vs Event RAG 1094.2 ms. Full History is slower and still worse on KL.

takeaways.title: Qwen 4B on Hugging Face Jobs
takeaways.body: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B LoRA on NVIDIA A10G. LifeMem KL 9.210 vs Profile 9.310; lowest KL is random_event (7.243). Last-wave SES silhouette drops from 0.39 (Profile) to 0.05 (LifeMem).

notes.restricted_data: Add Health and Understanding Society respondent files are not redistributable. This replication uses a synthetic six-wave panel with the paper's method, metrics, and hyperparameters. The default backbone is Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B.
notes.encoder: CPU replication uses a deterministic hashed n-gram encoder. The paper uses all-MiniLM-L6-v2 for LifeMem and bge-m3 for Event RAG.
notes.parametric_memory: CPU replication stores persistent QA bindings as a stand-in for per-agent LoRA. The Hugging Face Jobs path trains real PEFT adapters (rank 8, alpha 16, replay 4, two epochs per wave) on Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B.
notes.decay: Paper reports lambda=0.105; official configs set forgetting_alpha=0.9.
notes.gpu: GPU entry: scripts/submit_hf_job.py uploads sources and runs scripts/hf_job.py on a10g-small. Results land in data/gpu_results.json, the Hub dataset, and S3.
